overall: GOOD on the Coron side, MARGINAL overall: light wind, dry
limiterDetail: The main limiter is current , only in the south and west. Wind is light: ECMWF 2.1–7.1 kt now (gusts 5–11), staying under 7 kt into tonight, then building to 9–14 kt on Monday morning. Rain is not a factor today: dry, with only brief light showers (up to about 1 mm/h) possible around 6–8 AM Monday. The current picks up about 4–8 PM (peak around 6 PM), goes slack about 10 PM–3 AM , and picks up again about 6–9 AM Monday.

changed.title: ⚠️ What changed since this morning
items: No material change to supply: arrivals stay normal through Tuesday. With the morning current pickup over, the grounds are at 6 GOOD / 6 MARGINAL / 4 POOR / 0 VERY POOR right now (was 3 / 7 / 5 / 1 at 6 AM). Coron, Linapacan, Galoc, Maglalambay, Ciron and Panlaitan are GOOD; Decabaitot is back to POOR at 1.1 kt.

Watch Monday morning: wind builds to 9–14 kt from about 6 AM to 1 PM (strongest at Barangonan, 14 kt around 8 AM) with brief light showers around 6–8 AM. Week shifts: Wed 28 is now dry but windier (11 kt, gusts 16; was 3.5 mm rain). Thu 29 is still the hardest day (12 kt, gusts 20, 3.0 mm). Fri 30 is now dry (7.9 kt, gusts 18). Sat 31 still has moderate rain (13.4 mm). PAGASA has nothing for Palawan.
